plainTranslation: Composite Sun in Aries: the relationship runs on action, independence, and heat. Energized by starting and doing things together. At its best, this gives the relationship drive and aliveness. The pressure point is impatience, competition, and burning hot then cold.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from approved project composite chart material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
